I found nothing blocking in this candidate. There are three advisory points, listed below. HEAD equals the candidate, and the worktree was clean at the start and still is at the end. The `__pycache__` folders in it are gitignored, were created at 11:40–11:45 (before my first run at about 11:47), and I couldn't have written them because the worktree is read-only to me.

```
VERDICT: PASS
CANDIDATE: b77f355df3998fda6cc99f62f7cc422b0a0f10e9
FINDING deploy-prefix-untested advisory: the new env prefix at scripts/deploy_release.sh:254 (CRM_ADMIN_USERNAME=$CRM_ADMIN_USERNAME CRM_ADMIN_PASSWORD=$CRM_ADMIN_PASSWORD) does nothing. The script only gets these variables from its own environment, so they are already exported, and require_deploy_inputs (:219) makes sure they are set. No test notices if the line is removed. Harmless, and the WO allows it ("if they aren't already passed"). | evidence: mutation deleting line 254 → test_beta.py still "OK". The script only sources lib/common.sh (:44, :183) and never sources a file that sets the admin variables | expected: none needed. Optionally note in the comment that the line only makes explicit what is already passed.
FINDING redirect-forwards-auth advisory: UrllibTransport (scripts/crm_api.py:41-47, not changed here) uses the default urllib redirect handler. That handler copies custom headers onto the redirected request, so a 3xx from the target would carry Espo-Authorization (the admin basic token) to the redirect's host. Low risk: the base URL is beta's loopback URL from check_access.py (deploy_release.sh:241-243), and the API key already has the same exposure. | evidence: crm_api.py:42-44 calls urllib.request.urlopen(Request(..., headers=headers)) with no redirect handler | expected: in a later WO, refuse redirects in the transport (or at least in AdminRoleReader).
FINDING base64-secret-scan advisory: the unit tests check that output doesn't contain the username, the password, or the exact base64 token. ApiError carries only the method, path and status, with body b"", and nothing in the module prints or logs. So the checks are adequate, but they wouldn't catch a partial or re-encoded leak. | evidence: tests/unit/test_beta.py SECRETS tuple. A mutation that put admin._headers in the failure message was caught (FAILED failures=2) | expected: none.
EVIDENCE:
- git rev-parse HEAD → b77f355df3998fda6cc99f62f7cc422b0a0f10e9. git status --porcelain is empty before and after; the worktree is a read-only FS (touch → "Read-only file system").
- git diff --stat base..HEAD → docs/BETA.md, scripts/deploy_release.sh (+3), tests/acceptance/test_beta_safe.py, tests/unit/test_beta.py. All four are on the allowlist, and test_crm009.py is unchanged (git diff --quiet ok).
- gitleaks git --log-opts=468ffe57..b77f355 --redact --no-banner → "1 commits scanned … no leaks found" (rc 0). The only test values are fake: NOT-A-REAL-ADMIN-PASSWORD-9z, fake-admin-user-q7, NOT-A-REAL-DEPLOY-PASSWORD-k4.
- Dependencies: none added. Only stdlib base64 is imported.
- GET-only: AdminRoleReader (test_beta_safe.py:124-142) subclasses ReadOnlyClient. Its single request goes through transport.request("GET", url, headers, None), and any path other than exactly "Role" is refused before a request is made (:139-141). Other checks use CLIENT with the API key (:183, :186, :237). The role check builds the admin reader on the spot and fails without credentials (self.fail, :193-196), never skips. The credentials are kept only as the header and dropped with `del admin`. Passwords never reach argv: deploy passes them by env only, and run_beta_safe's argv is just "$dest" (:198-207). No set -x anywhere (set -euo pipefail at :42).
- Docs (BETA.md): the manual run uses read -rs, so the password stays out of argv and shell history, followed by unset.
- Unit suite run as uid 1002 (forgev2-pl, non-root) on a git-archive copy in scratch with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and -B: 561 tests OK (skipped=1). The one skip is "no Git metadata, or the mode change is not yet committed" (sandbox, unrelated). test_beta.py: 103 OK.
- Mutations (test_beta.py result): fail→skipTest ⇒ FAILED(4); PATHS guard removed ⇒ FAILED(1,E6); prefix match "Role*" ⇒ FAILED(1,E1); role check using the API key ⇒ FAILED(15); admin used for Account ⇒ FAILED(15); header in the failure message ⇒ FAILED(2); password added to run_beta_safe argv ⇒ FAILED(1); deploy prefix line removed ⇒ OK (advisory deploy-prefix-untested).
- No other deploy behaviour changed: the only diff in deploy_release.sh is the 3 lines at 252-254. No containers were started and no network was used.
```
